data.name: Raqeeb
data.gender_notes: Raqeeb is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who guards, protects, and keeps watch over something. The name Raqeeb carries the meaning “Watchman” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raqeeb usually hope their child will grow to embody watchman and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Raqeeb belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Watchman.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raqeeb total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: رَقِيب
in_arabic.long_meaning: الرَقِيب: السيد الموقر الذي يراقب ويحاسب ويجازى العمل. يُعتبر اسمًا مشتقًا من الجذر رَقَبيَ، يعني مراقبة وحراسة. يُستخدم اسم الراقب في القرآن الكريم في سورتي الأعراف وأحزاب، للإشارة إلى الله يراقب عباده ويحاسبهم. في الإسلام، يُعتبر الراقب من أهم الأسماء التي تميز الشخصية، حيث يرمز إلى شخص يتبع قواعد الله ويحافظ على الصواب والعدل.

in_urdu.name: رقیقب
in_urdu.long_meaning: رقیقب: ایک وہ شخص جو اپنے کاموں کا حساب لیتا ہے اور ان کے لئے جزا بھی دیتا ہے۔ یہ اسم عربی زبان کے جوڑے (رَقَبی) سے ماخوذ ہے جو مراقبت اور حفاظت کے معنی میں آتا ہے۔ قرآن مجید میں سورہ آل عمران میں اللہ تعالیٰ کا نام لیتے ہوئے اس کا ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ اس اسم سے مراد وہ شخص ہے جو اللہ تعالیٰ کے احکام اور قواعد کو پورا کرتا ہے اور اپنے کاموں میں سچائی اور انصاف کا مظاہرہ کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रक़ीख़
in_hindi.long_meaning: रक़ीख़: एक व्यक्ति जो अपने कार्यों का खाता रखता है और उन्हें सजा भी देता है। इस नाम का अर्थ है मराकब या रक्षित करना। यह शब्द अरबी भाषा के जोड़ 'रक़बी' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है रक्षा या रक्षित करना। कुरआन में इस नाम का उल्लेख सूरह अल-अअराफ और सूरह अहजाब में किया गया है। इस्लाम में यह नाम एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है जो व्यक्ति के चरित्र को दर्शाता है। यह व्यक्ति को न्यायपूर्ण और न्यायशील बनाता है।

in_pashto.name: رقيقب
in_pashto.long_meaning: رقيقب: د لوی واکمن چا چی دې کارونه کوي په دې ډول چې د هغوی د کارونو په اړه د هغوی د څېړنې پر بنسټ د جزا ورکوي. دا نوم د «رَقَبی» جګړې لخوا اخیستل شوی دی چې د مراقبت او حوالې کولو پېښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. په قرآن کې یې په سورې «الأعراف» او «الحجرات» کې یادونه شوې ده. دا نوم په افغانستان او پښتونخوا کې د خپل نړیوالې پېژندنې له کوندي لپاره د یو کس لپاره غوره نوم دی.

in_english.name: Raqeeb
in_english.long_meaning: Raqeeb: A righteous and just person who observes, accounts for, and judges the actions of others. The name is derived from the Arabic root R-Q-B, meaning observation, oversight, and protection. In the Quran, Allah is referred to as Raqqib in Surah Al-Araf and Al-Ahzab, signifying His observation and oversight of humanity. In Islamic tradition, the name Raqqib represents a person who adheres to the principles of justice and righteousness, always observing and judging their actions in accordance with divine guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Raqeeb holds significant cultural importance in Islamic society as it signifies a person who guards and protects something valuable. This could be in the context of a family, a community, or a nation. Raqeebs are known for their dedication, vigilance, and sense of responsibility, making them highly respected members of Islamic communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Raqeeb takes on a deeper meaning. It can be seen as a reflection of the divine attributes of Allah SWT, who is the Guardian and Protector of all creation. As Muslims, we are called to be raqeebs of our own souls, guarding and protecting them from the destructive influences of Shaitan and our own lower desires. In this way, the name Raqeeb serves as a reminder of our duty to Allah, and our responsibility to guard and protect ourselves, our families, and our communities, in accordance with His will.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Watchman" symbolizes The one who guards, protects, and keeps watch over something. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Raqeeb serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of watchman.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Hajar al-Haytami, in his book Al-Fatawa al-Hadithah, mentions a man called Raqeeb. The name Raqeeb carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ibn Hajar al-Haytami was a prominent Islamic scholar and jurist.
